public_rationale: TIME's investigation, based on payslips and internal documents, found that Sama's Kenyan labellers working for OpenAI took home about $1.32 to $2 per hour. It also found that the text they labelled included graphic descriptions of child sexual abuse and bestiality. OpenAI confirmed that this work fed a toxic-content detector built into ChatGPT. Sama disputed the pay, saying workers could earn $1.46 to $3.74 per hour, but would not say which roles earned the top rates. The most junior agents, who were most of the workforce, took home $1.32–$1.44. The claim matches the reporting.
limitations: Relies on one investigative report, though OpenAI confirmed the core facts.
Senior analysts could reach $2, not strictly less.
